interactions.notes: Polymer agar clearing assay (Table S2): the reaction of this isolate on PHB agar was scored '+' (weak positive reaction); assays were run in triplicate and the paper reports no zone diameter, incubation temperature or duration. The paper reports this isolate as 'Candida sp.'. NCBI Taxonomy resolves that string to the node '[Candida] sp.' (NCBI:txid1853550); the square brackets are NCBI's own marker for a generic assignment it regards as unsettled, and the name is stored exactly as NCBI holds it. Isolate recovered from the agricultural soil/perlite mixture (SSP) at the start of the experiment.
